description_en: Sends a user prompt to a specified session and streams the agent response by using Server-Sent Events (SSE)
description_zh: 向指定会话发送用户Prompt，并以SSE方式流式接收Agent响应
name: PromptAgentSession

parameters.help_en: The JSON-RPC version. Set the value to 2.0
parameters.name: jsonrpc

parameters.help_en: The ID passed by the requester, which is echoed back as is
parameters.help_zh: 请求方传入的 id，原样回显
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The request source identifier. Set the value to product=HOLOGRES
parameters.name: caller_context

fields.help_en: The map type. In custom agent scenarios, some placeholder parameters can be replaced by using this value
fields.help_zh: Map 类型，对于自定义 Agent 场景下，有些占位符参数可以通过该值进行替换
fields.name: context

fields.help_en: The file description. This parameter takes effect when Type is set to resource_link
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the prompt is hidden from the user
fields.help_zh: 该 Prompt 是否对用户隐藏不显示
fields.name: hide

fields.help_zh: 扩展的 Prompt 元信息
fields.name: meta

fields.help_en: The MIME type of the file. This parameter takes effect when Type is set to resource_link
fields.help_zh: 文件 MIME 类型，Type= resource_link下生效
fields.name: mime_type

fields.help_en: The file name. This parameter takes effect when Type is set to resource_link
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The size of the file. Unit: bytes. This parameter takes effect when Type is set to resource_link
fields.help_zh: 文件的大小，单位：byte，Type= resource_link下生效
fields.name: size

fields.example: How many skills do you have?
fields.help_en: The text content. This parameter takes effect when Type is set to text
fields.name: text

fields.help_en: The file title. This parameter takes effect when Type is set to resource_link
fields.name: title

fields.help_en: The content block type. Only text is supported
fields.help_zh: 内容块类型，目前仅支持：text
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The URI of the file. This parameter takes effect when Type is set to resource_link
fields.help_zh: 文件的 URI，Type= resource_link 下生效
fields.name: uri

fields.help_en: The array of user message content blocks. For more information, see https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/content
fields.name: prompt

fields.help_en: The ID of the target session. If the session does not exist, an SSE error frame is returned
fields.help_zh: 目标会话 ID，不存在会返回 SSE error 帧
fields.name: session_id

Error.description_en: The error message in the SSE frame. The returned content complies with the open-source Agent Client Protocol (ACP) specification. For more information, see https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/prompt-turn
Error.description_zh: SSE 的帧信息错误提示，返回的内容符合开源协议 Agent Client Protocol (ACP) 的规范，具体可以参考：https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/prompt-turn

Id.description_en: The ID passed by the requester, which is echoed back as is
Id.description_zh: 请求方传入的 id，原样回显

Jsonrpc.description_en: The JSON-RPC version. Set the value to 2.0

Method.description_en: The method in the SSE frame. The returned content complies with the open-source Agent Client Protocol (ACP) specification. For more information, see https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/prompt-turn
Method.description_zh: SSE 的 method，返回的内容符合开源协议 Agent Client Protocol (ACP) 的规范，具体可以参考：https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/prompt-turn

Params.description_en: The parameters in the SSE frame. The returned content complies with the open-source Agent Client Protocol (ACP) specification. For more information, see https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/prompt-turn
Params.description_zh: SSE 的 params，返回的内容符合开源协议 Agent Client Protocol (ACP) 的规范，具体可以参考：https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/prompt-turn

Result.description_en: The result set in the SSE frame. The returned content complies with the open-source Agent Client Protocol (ACP) specification. For more information, see https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/prompt-turn
Result.description_zh: SSE 的帧结果集，返回的内容符合开源协议 Agent Client Protocol (ACP) 的规范，具体可以参考：https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/prompt-turn
